title: Felix and the Interior
author: Dominic Lockridge
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
